correctness.rationale: Direct exact normalized reproducing-kernel Gram calculation plus Schur complement. The nonstandard global midpoint lemma follows by differentiating e^{-h²}(cosh(Lh)-e^{-L²/2}); the auxiliary threshold A(u) is strictly increasing and above u, so the relevant function attains its maximum only at endpoints, with unique strict midpoint optimum. Symmetry block diagonalization yields exact eigenvalues. Rank-one compression and Taylor determinant expansion give sharp L² and L⁴ collision coefficients. Packaged mpmath checker independently reproduced 431 finite comparisons; experiments are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The natural exact maximal uncertainty between two prescribed Gaussian/Fock sampling sites is shown to occur uniquely at the midpoint at every separation, with a closed sharp error scale. The same configuration has a fully explicit Gram spectrum and the general three-site collision develops an exactly quantified weak information mode, including sharp fractional-location leading coefficient and midpoint condition-number blowup.
